title: Pharax
summary: Raleigh names Pharax in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Pharax, Admirall of the fleet, appointed to joyne with Dercyllidas in Caria. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter XI, §. II, sig. 446b–447a
